questions.a: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Free shipping on orders over $50.
We currently ship to the US and Canada. International shipping to Europe is coming in Q2 2025.

questions.q: How do I track my order?
questions.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking email with a USPS or UPS tracking number. You can also check your order status on your account page.

questions.q: What are your candles made of?
questions.a: All Wick & Glow candles are made from 100% natural soy wax with cotton wicks and premium fragrance oils. We never use paraffin or synthetic additives.

questions.q: How long do your candles burn?
questions.a: Our 8oz candles burn for approximately 45-50 hours. Our 16oz candles burn for approximately 90-100 hours. Always trim the wick to 1/4 inch before lighting.

questions.q: Are your candles safe for pets?
questions.a: Our soy candles are non-toxic and generally safe around pets. However, we recommend keeping candles out of reach and ensuring good ventilation. Our essential-oil-free line is specifically designed for pet owners.
We offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. Unused candles in original packaging can be returned for a full refund. Used candles can be returned within 14 days if you're unsatisfied with the scent.

questions.q: How do I request a refund?
questions.a: Email support@wickandglow.com with your order number and reason for return. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.

questions.q: Do you offer a subscription service?
questions.a: Yes! Our Glow Box subscription delivers a curated candle each month for $24.99/month. Subscribers get 15% off all other purchases and early access to new scents.

questions.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.a: You can cancel your Glow Box subscription anytime from your account settings. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No cancellation fees.
